# Maui Mini Session - Full Content Summary

> Express 20-minute portrait sessions in Wailea and South Maui, from $299. Maui's original mini session - honest pricing, fast delivery, family-run. Run by the Balter family, the same family behind Wailea Photo (https://waileaphoto.com).

## About
Maui Mini Session is a family-run portrait studio created by the Balter family, who have photographed Maui for more than 25 years. Every session is shot by their own team - never an outside contractor. It is the express portrait offering from Wailea Photo.

Contact: +1-808-298-5188 / info@mauiminisession.com / https://www.instagram.com/mauiminisession / https://www.facebook.com/mauiminisession
Address: 3704 S Kihei Rd, Kihei, HI 96753

## Sessions & Pricing
Each 20-minute session includes calm direction from an experienced Maui photographer and at least 25 naturally edited, high-resolution digital images delivered in an online gallery within 24-48 hours. Listed price includes up to five people; additional-person pricing shown on the live booking calendar.

- Morning Mini Session - from $299. Soft morning light, cooler temperatures and a quieter Wailea beach. Good for early risers adjusting to Hawaii time.
- Sunset Mini Session - from $299. Warm evening light, ocean color and the possibility of a dramatic Maui sunset.
- Turquoise Mini Session - from $299. Bright water, tropical color, and a relaxed Maui shoreline.

Live booking: https://mauiminisession.com/#sessions

## What to Wear
Soft neutrals, whites, cream, sky blues and muted earth tones blend well with South Maui's sand and turquoise ocean. Linen shorts, flowy dresses and breathable cotton hold up in ocean breeze and warm coastal air. Barefoot or sandals work well on the sand. Avoid heavy logos, matching uniform outfits and bright neon colors.

## FAQ
What is included in a Maui Mini Session?
Each 20-minute session includes calm direction from an experienced Maui photographer and at least 25 naturally edited, high-resolution digital images delivered in an online gallery.

How quickly will we receive our photographs?
Your edited online gallery is delivered within 24 to 48 hours after your session.

How many people are included in the listed price?
The listed session price includes up to five people. Additional-person pricing is shown on the live booking calendar.

Are mini sessions suitable for children and couples?
Yes. The short, calmly directed format works well for families with children, couples, maternity portraits and small multigenerational groups.

What happens if Maui weather does not cooperate?
You may reschedule before your session if the weather is not cooperating.

Where do the sessions take place?
Sessions are photographed at carefully selected shoreline locations in Wailea and South Maui. Meeting details are provided upon booking.

Wailea Photo (https://waileaphoto.com) is the parent studio, offering full-length family, couples and wedding sessions by the same family.
